source_frontmatter.name: website-content
source_frontmatter.description: Write or update content for Mick Pletcher's personal website. Trigger when Mick asks to write, rewrite, or update any section of his personal site including About, Projects, Skills, Blog integration, AI and homelab showcase, health and sports, contact copy, landing page sections, SEO descriptions, or project writeups. Tone is polished and professional, closer to LinkedIn than the blog, but still first-person and direct. Avoid corporate-speak. No emojis. Avoid em dashes in final website copy.

transformations.- if a claim has no available proof, cut:
- if a claim has no available proof, cut it or scope it down rather than leaving it vague
- do not turn an operation sequence into an unverified safety guarantee: a preview before a move does not establish that the preview leaves originals unchanged
transformations.When layout constraints are unknown or t: When layout constraints are unknown and the user has not requested a single length, return both labeled versions of each section: `Concise` (1 to 2 sentences per block) and `Detailed` (full paragraphs). Also provide both when the user asks for variants. A single unlabeled draft does not satisfy this default. If the user explicitly requests one length, honor that request. Both versions must carry the same facts; concise copy cuts context, not specifics.
